verdict.rationale: Zep gives each user their own Context Graph: messages are ingested into the user-level graph, and Zep users mirror your app's users. ABAC policies attached to API keys and UserGroups limit which context each agent and Memory MCP user can reach, and zepctl administers separate projects, which suggests application-level separation. Missing for 10: an explicit per-agent memory namespace (as opposed to access policies), documented project-level isolation guarantees, and independent or hands-on confirmation that retrieval never crosses tenant boundaries.
